name: Physical fire-source anchor
measurable_method_signal: A2 cross-batch offset lowers V matched-point median error in B3/B4 (17.88/33.06px vs centers 35.40/52.56px); B3 North downstream geolocation A2 12.454m vs center 12.284m.
known_failure_or_gap: Pixel offset improves cross-batch matched points; no independent downstream LRF gain; B3 North pixel gain does not improve localization.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Temporal physical-source estimation
measurable_method_signal: Trailing median slightly improves within-clip pixel point error; no motion compensation or physical accuracy evidence.
known_failure_or_gap: Trailing median reduces conditional pixel error modestly; motion compensation/downstream error not established.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Unregistered RGB-T source alignment
measurable_method_signal: SIFT homography spatial support 19/99 (B1 1/21, B2 0/27); fixed transform fails broad support.
known_failure_or_gap: Fixed SIFT homography has spatial support in 19/99; B1 1/21, B2 0/27; no source-level cross-session ground truth.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Thermal-assisted active source observation recovery
measurable_method_signal: Old benchmark T-only source points 13/52; T-only active moments 9/32. New center review 3/25 V-miss/T-hit. T also triggered on residual/hot backgrounds.
known_failure_or_gap: Old T-only recovery 13/52 points and 9/32 active moments; new review finds 3/25 center-frame V misses with T hits, but residual/hot backgrounds trigger T and a held-out gate is untested.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Fire-state recognition
measurable_method_signal: All states observed in labels; difficult states are concentrated in single clips. No event-independent classifier signal.
known_failure_or_gap: States are present but rare states are event-confounded; random frame split would leak same event.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Multi-UAV geometry
measurable_method_signal: Visual correction improved 2/4 historical fire-linked sites, worsened B1/B4. New B3 variants preserve 11.535m North miss.
known_failure_or_gap: C0 has a 13.283 m B3 North miss; background visual correction improves only 2/4 historical fire sites and worsens others; C1-C4 are B3-only.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Reliability / selective geolocation
measurable_method_signal: B3_N has 1.185m residual and 0.813m max C0 LOUO shift but 13.283m Gold error; selective risk cannot be learned.
known_failure_or_gap: B3_N low ray residual and low LOUO spread still hide 11-13m bias; no calibrated selective-risk threshold.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Cross-UAV same-source association
measurable_method_signal: B3 one-event correct/mixed residual margin; held-out conditional 6/6. B4 6/6 also conditional but identity provisional and projection errors 80-288px.
known_failure_or_gap: B3 held-out subset probe 6/6 under manual IDs; B4 conditional 6/6 with 80-288px self error but IDs unverified; cannot claim cross-event performance.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Camera-mode / boresight calibration
measurable_method_signal: Zoom LRF bearing median 0.05deg vs Wide 5.44deg; not an image optical-axis calibration and confounded.
known_failure_or_gap: Zoom bearing median 0.05° vs Wide 5.44° is a signal but modes/sites are confounded and image boresight is unmeasured.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Cross-UAV background self-calibration
measurable_method_signal: B1-B4 background graphs connect; B4 free SfM 14.186m vs nominal 0.109m in LRF probe.
known_failure_or_gap: B4 free SfM is 14.186m vs nominal 0.109m despite viable reconstruction; background fit alone has not shown reliable absolute gains.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Oracle error decomposition
measurable_method_signal: B3 North remains 12.676m off with manual anchor under C2; South 0.711m manually but frozen V gives only one ray.
known_failure_or_gap: North manual source remains 12.68m wrong; South manual is 0.71m but auto V lacks views; other oracle cells unavailable.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Smoke detection / domain generalization
measurable_method_signal: Historical target val/test overlap 45/45; target train overlap 10/45; Detection train overlap 3150/3150.
known_failure_or_gap: Prior protocol has exact train/val/test leakage; both local theses already cover smoke detection/domain adaptation.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Small / early smoke
measurable_method_signal: Historical tiny recall 0.818 vs small 0.915 at confidence .25 (44 vs 141 boxes); event/onset validity absent.
known_failure_or_gap: Tiny recall 0.818 vs small 0.915 at confidence .25 is descriptive; no early timestamp or event-independent split.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: RGB-T multi-view joint graph
measurable_method_signal: No joint source graph metrics; 2,401 V/T pairs are candidate_unreviewed.
independent_event_evidence: 0 independently verified multi-UAV source moments at >=4
known_failure_or_gap: No verified joint identity intersection; graph model would learn unverified edges.

name: Consensus-supervised source learning
measurable_method_signal: 20 new 5-9 UAV instants/298 frames staged, all Candidate; there are zero manually verified >=4-UAV source moments.
known_failure_or_gap: No N>=4 manual source moment and stable-but-wrong 3-view Silver falsifies use of consensus spread as confidence.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Shared systematic-bias diagnosis
measurable_method_signal: One reproducible stable-but-biased counterexample; shared yaw/pitch/focal/GPS sweeps on three linked LRF sites do not identify cause.
known_failure_or_gap: B3_N remains a stable 11-13m failure under visual variants; one-factor sweeps cannot identify the cause, and per-mode/drone effects are confounded.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Cross-UAV synchronization
measurable_method_signal: Creation-time metadata spreads measured in candidate frames, but no physical sync offsets/drift or perturbation-to-error curve.
known_failure_or_gap: Creation metadata can expose nominal mismatch but cannot estimate sensor offset/drift or its geometry effect without matched timed events.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table

name: Relative geometric source mapping
measurable_method_signal: B3 one event own-vs-other reprojection separation; B4 scene is multi-source visually but cross-UAV source ID is not independent.
known_failure_or_gap: B3 geometry separated own/other source for held-out views; B4 topology looks multi-source but IDs are not independently confirmed; relative map is promising but one-event only.
truth_level: Experiment evidence; see scoped truth table
